study: GMPB grouping / intensification mechanism ablation of the Squid Game Optimizer
purpose: diagnostic mechanism test, not an attempt to improve SGO

sgo_identity.name: Squid Game Optimizer
sgo_identity.reference: Azizi, Baghalzadeh Shishehgarkhaneh, Basiri, Moehler, Scientific Reports 13:5373 (2023)

benchmark.benchmark_seed: run index; environment trajectory identical to the committed baseline

intervention.rule_baseline: fresh uniformly random permutation each iteration; half offensive, half defensive
intervention.rule_intervention: stable argsort of current evaluated cost; best half offensive, worst half defensive

settings.fe_accounting: official GMPB; sorting consumes no objective evaluations

diagnostics.diversity: mean(std(X,axis=0))/(ub-lb), first completed iteration at or after each target fraction, actual fraction stored
diagnostics.error_trace: official CurrentError at the same fractions

hypotheses.H1: fitness grouping lowers persistent population diversity
hypotheses.H2: fitness grouping shifts improvement later in the environment and/or raises the evaluation fraction to 90% recovery
hypotheses.H3: fitness grouping reduces official offline error
hypotheses.H4: if H1-H3 hold under persistence but vanish under previous-best seeding, grouping and stale carryover interact strongly
hypotheses.H5: if the effect survives under previous-best seeding, grouping acts beyond stale carryover
hypotheses.H6: the effect need not appear on every case

statistics.pseudoreplication_control: environment-level data aggregated to one value per run before any test
statistics.paired_test: Wilcoxon signed-rank on 31 paired benchmark seeds
statistics.correction: Holm across the 12 primary case comparisons, and within each diagnostic family
statistics.interaction: paired fitness-minus-random effect within each temporal mode plus a difference-of-differences summary

prohibited: naming the intervention as a new algorithm
comparing the intervention with GWO/PSO/WOA as though it were the original algorithm
using 'cause' merely because offline error improves
changing the manuscript's object of study away from vanilla SGO
